name: Ping Monitor
author: Widgeter
description: Pings a list of hosts you choose and shows latency, history and packet loss for each, using the system ping.

config.label: Hosts to ping
config.default:
1.1.1.1 | Cloudflare DNS
8.8.8.8 | Google DNS
google.com | Google
github.com | GitHub
config.placeholder: one host per line, optional label after |
config.help: One host or IP per line. Add a label after a | character, e.g. 192.168.1.1 | Router. Up to 12 hosts.
